Interpretation and limits
Several numbers conflict within the article. Figure 2 shows 61.4% preferred closed-ended questions and 7.9% preferred open-ended; §3.1.2 says 60.0% preferred open-ended. For aggregate decoy target completion, §3.2.2 reports 55.9% while Table 2 shows 59.8%. The order-specific rates and adjusted odds ratios are shown separately. The Bench choice-only adaptation does not measure completion.

Participants, procedure and measures
Of 210 invitations, 203 were delivered. Recipients saw the eight-item target survey alone or alongside an open-ended alternative with later payment. Order was randomized between people in the two-option arm. Six people who completed the alternative were counted as not completing the target.

result
What the paper reports
scope-02
result
Result
Target completion was 32.7% in control, 82.7% with target first and 28.0% with decoy first. The corresponding adjusted odds ratios vs control were 11.18 (95% CI 4.57–27.33) and 0.75 (95% CI 0.34–1.63). See the reading note for the conflicting pooled percentage.
